settings.title: OBD-II & indicator source

options.title: Real OBD brake lamp when connected, HMG-API model otherwise (Recommended)
HMG-API model drives icon (live accuracy & lag test vs OBD)

settings.description: Connects via @gen5w_ble directly first, falling back automatically to 127.0.0.1:35000 if obd-gen5w holds the BLE link. Both OBD modes log synchronized HMG-API + OBD ground-truth rows in RAM for USB CSV export.

settings.title: HMG-API brake model mode

options.title: Brake pressure + Regen / Smart Cruise deceleration & hold (Recommended)

settings.description: Recommended mode combines HMG-API brake.pressure with longitudinal speed deceleration and standstill hold so Level 2/3 regen, i-Pedal, and Smart Cruise Control illuminate the indicator without OBD.

settings.title: When brake lights are off
settings.description: Controls whether the top-bar icon disappears completely or stays faintly visible as a dark-grey outline when unlit.

settings.title: Top-bar horizontal anchor
settings.description: Selects which edge of the top row x_offset is measured from.

settings.title: Horizontal offset (px)
settings.description: Distance in pixels from the anchor (for Top center, signed offset from center). Default 260 sits cleanly to the left of the clock and status icons on 1920x720 screens.

settings.title: Vertical offset from top (px)
settings.description: Distance in pixels from the top edge of the screen.

settings.title: Icon height (px)
settings.description: Height of the top-bar brake lamp icon in pixels (20 to 96; stock Gen5W status icons are 36 px tall).

settings.title: Brake pressure threshold (tenths)
settings.description: Minimum HMG-API brake.pressure reading in tenths (4 = 0.4) to treat foot-pedal or IEB hydraulic braking as active.

settings.title: Regen / cruise deceleration threshold (tenths of m/s^2)
settings.description: Minimum longitudinal deceleration in tenths of m/s^2 (12 = 1.2 m/s^2, matching E-GMP UNECE R13-H stop-lamp onset) when Regen / Smart Cruise detection is enabled.

settings.title: Hold at standstill after regen / cruise stop
settings.description: Keeps the HMG-API model illuminated at 0 km/h after decelerating to a stop in i-Pedal or Smart Cruise Control until throttle is applied, the car moves, or Park is selected.

settings.title: Loopback ELM327 fallback port
settings.description: Localhost TCP port (127.0.0.1) tried automatically when @gen5w_ble direct BLE is busy (e.g. obd-gen5w loopback bridge).
